text: In this world, your hair changes color with your mood.
Happy is yellow. Mad is red. Sad is blue.
And pink... means you like someone.
Grandma's hair goes red when she loses the TV remote.
And my teacher's hair turns blue every Monday morning.
Me? Every time I see Lily, my hair goes bright pink.
So I wear a cap. Every single day.
Kids call me Hat Boy.
Then one day... picture day.
The photographer yelled, hats off, everybody!
speaker: photographer

text: And guess who was standing right next to me?
Lily.
Subscribe, because my hair was about to snitch.
I thought about homework. Blue!
Then Lily said hi. Pink!
I thought about broccoli. Blue!
Lily giggled. Super pink!
Then Brayden pointed and yelled, Nubi likes somebody!
speaker: brayden

text: The whole class turned around.
But Brayden's hair was pink too. Kayla had just waved at him.
That's when I realized something. Everybody goes pink for someone.
So why hide it?
Then Lily whispered... look at mine.
speaker: lily

text: Her hair was pink. It had been pink all year.
I just never looked up from my shoes.
